reason: The submitted P422, Z=1 model is sufficiently established. Its tetragonal cell indexes all substantive reflections, and the explicit ordered Tl3In5Se8 realization reproduces both the main intensities and the weak 100/001 superstructure reflections that distinguish it from the parent centered framework; an independent simple whole-profile check gives an unweighted profile residual of about 4.5%. The geometry is physically credible (density about 6.36 g/cm3, shortest In-Se about 2.65 A, and Tl-Se about 3.52 A). The trajectory instantiated all 56 Tl/In assignments on the identified cation framework: assignments placing Tl on the tetrahedral In sublattice fit materially worse and predict incorrect low-angle intensity, while the four tied best assignments are crystallographically equivalent origin/domain descriptions rather than distinct surviving orderings. Although no externally comparable Rwp was supplied, the profile, peak-level, ordering, symmetry, stoichiometry, and round-trip evidence leave no scientifically motivated materially different candidate likely to improve the set.
